Nagara Temple Architecture

A two-hour masterclass, online or at your venue

On request

Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and location. We adapt the length, level and language, and prepare a quotation. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

In this masterclass you distinguish northern temple forms through comparative plans.

Length, level and language are agreed with you. It can be given online or at your venue, as a single session or as part of a series.

What it covers

  • Type vocabulary
  • Regional comparisons
  • Khajuraho reading

How the time is spent

  1. Type vocabulary 30 min

    Latina, śekharī and bhūmija terms with examples.

    You: classify sample elevations

  2. Regional comparisons 60 min

    Compare central India, Rajasthan and western India case studies.

    You: morphology grid

  3. Khajuraho reading 30 min

    Analyse plan and superstructure.

    You: label photograph

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

An activity sheet to keep.
